title: Same Rules, New Feel: A 3D Makeover for Solved Tic-Tac-Toe
subtitle: Tic-tac-toe is a solved game — optimal play always ends in a draw. See how 3D rotation, sound and confetti rebuild the feel without changing a single rule.
corePoints: Separation of rule logic and presentation layer
Minimax algorithm applied to a 'solved' game
Juice enhances feel without altering core rules

breakdown.title: Rule Skeleton
bullets: 3×3 grid, X goes first, players take turns
Draw if full without a winner; no failure penalty

breakdown.title: Turn Core Loop
bullets: Player move → AI response (minimax) → Grid rotation → Render next frame
Rotation changes only camera view, not logical grid positions
State machine: menu → gameplay → result, supports restart and return to menu

breakdown.title: Presentation Layer Juice
bullets: Three.js 3D grid with post-turn rotation animation
Victory confetti and Web Audio real-time sound effects
Rules remain unchanged, but player experience is completely transformed
